title: Oven Roasted Egyptian Pork Kebabs
description: Buttery and flaky Egyptian dish featuring pork shoulder steaks in a miso marinate, perfect for a low-calorie dinner option
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, and paprika
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the miso marinate
Thread the marinated pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
Roast the pork kebabs in the preheated oven for 20 minutes
Flip the kebabs over and continue roasting for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until cooked through
Remove the kebabs from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving
